navigation Markdown Gatekeeper Markdown Gatekeeper is a localfirst authority layer for projects where humans, Claude, Codex, and other agents create overlapping Markdown documents. It keeps ordinary Markdown and local Git. It adds one rule: a document does not become current authority merely because an agent calls it authoritative. Status This repository is the first dogfood implementation. It intentionally has no cloud service and no MCP dependency. Quick start Until the npm registry release is available, install the CLI directly from GitHub: npm install g github:nanlogic/markdowngatekeeper After the package is published to npm, the equivalent command is npm install g markdowngatekeeper. Install the matching Skill and bootstrap for the Agent host you use: mdg setup codex mdg setup claude mdg setup status Run only the setup command for hosts you have installed. mdg setup codex manages the Skill, launcher, and bootstrap under $CODEX_HOME or ~/.codex; mdg setup claude does the same under $CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR or ~/.claude. Each host keeps its own native instruction file and launcher. The launchers use absolute Node and package paths, so GUI sessions do not depend on npm's global executable directory being present in PATH. During local development, use npm link in this repository instead of installing globally from GitHub. New Codex tasks and Claude Code sessions then detect managed projects automatically, while unrelated global instructions and unmanaged projects are left alone. Initialize and organize an existing project with one command: mdg init . mdg init . is zerotouch: it completes discovery, review, safe highconfidence publication, archiving, Evidence, and integrity checks without another confirmation. It prefers an isolated Codex CLI, enforces a threeminute reviewer timeout, and can fall back to the current Codex or Claude Code Session when the command is started with hostsession codex or hostsession claude. items.author: sacravenger
items.descZh: 这是 nanlogic 开源的 Markdown Gatekeeper（mdg），一款面向 AI 代理协作场景的本地优先"权威层"工具。随着 Claude、Codex 等代理在项目中大量生成 Markdown 文档，如何界定哪些文档具有"权威性"成为新痛点，mdg 通过 `.authority` 目录和 Evidence 机制确保代理不能仅凭自述就将文档升级为权威。其核心功能包括：`mdg setup codex/claude` 为各 Agent 宿主自动安装 Skill、启动器与 bootstrap，`mdg init .` 一键完成零交互的发现、审查、安全发布与完整性校验；启动器使用绝对路径，不依赖 npm 全局 PATH。亮点方面，`mdg init` 是 zerotouch 全自动流程，强制执行 3 分钟审阅者超时，并优先使用隔离的 Codex CLI，支持 hostsession 降级到当前会话；项目明确"故意不依赖云服务和 MCP"，仓库目前仅 9 次提交，是首个 dogfood 实现。适用场景为多人与多 AI 代理（Claude、Codex 等）共同编辑同一项目文档、且需要严格区分普通 Markdown 与权威文档的团队。当前需通过 `npm install -g github:nanlogic/markdowngatekeeper` 从 GitHub 直接安装，npm 正式发布后将切换为 `npm install -g markdowngatekeeper`。
items.quote: 一份文件并不会仅仅因为某个代理称其为权威而自动成为当前权威。

items.descZh:
Haserupt 是一款主打"按需限时"的屏幕时间管理应用，区别于传统的每日限额或定时专注模式，它的核心思路是在用户每次打开应用前先询问意图，根据意图分配刚好够用的使用时长。用完即锁，并设置短暂的冷静期来抑制冲动续用；若确有需要，用户可以延长一次时间。整体设计强调"先问后用"，把主动权从规则执行转向意图引导，而非单纯限制。

亮点在于把干预点前置到"打开前"这一关键瞬间，避免了用户进入应用后才被中断的对抗感；冷静期机制则利用短暂等待削弱即时渴望，配合一次性的延长许可，兼顾了灵活性与节制。适合那些容易被短视频、社交媒体等高频应用牵走注意力、又对硬性限额或番茄钟类定时专注接受度不高的用户，能在保留应用可及性的同时帮助重建有意识的打开习惯。
items.quote: Haserupt 并不设每日时长限制或定时专注时段，而是在你打开应用之前先询问你打开它是为了做什么。

files Repository files navigation pycanon One versioned standard for the fleet's Python packages, plus the machinery that keeps \~50 repos on it without copypaste. The standard: [STANDARD.md](/gojiplus/pycanon/blob/main/STANDARD.md) covers uv, ruff, pyright, google docstrings, src layout, typed runtime assets, Hugging Face model storage, tagdriven releases with trusted publishing, and Sphinx with furo. Changing the fleet's mind is a PR to that file and the assets here. The machinery (DRY hierarchy — reference where possible, materialize only where forced): Layer Lives here as Repos consume it via Propagation CI / docs / release logic .github/workflows/reusable\.yml 5line workflow shims uses: gojiplus/pycanon/.github/workflows/reusableci.yml@v1 Instant on next run Sphinx config src/py\_canon/sphinx.py docs/conf.py: from py\_canon.sphinx import configure; configure(globals()) Next docs build Scaffolding + \[tool.\\] config template/ (copier) preen new / preen adopt New repos only — see below The first two rows are references: a workflow shim names @v1 and GitHub resolves it at run time, and docs/conf.py imports py_canon.sphinx. Nothing is copied, so moving v1 is the whole propagation mechanism. The third row cannot work that way. [tool.ruff] has to live in _your_ pyproject.toml and .precommitconfig.yaml in _your_ repo — those tools read their own file and have no way to extend a URL. So the bytes are materialized into each repo, and materialized bytes drift. Two known gaps, both measured rather than assumed: The Sphinx layer goes stale. pycanon @ git+...@v1 moves, but uv.lockfreezes the commit it resolved to. gojiplus/sharepack was pinned eighteen commits behind the v1 it claims to track. A lock refresh is what lands it. copier update does not currently propagate anything. Repos record _commit: v1, a _moving_ tag, so copier compares v1 against v1 and reports "Keeping template version 1". When it does act it can delete: on appeler/naamkaran it removed Citation.cff outright, because the repo spells it that way and the template ships CITATION.cff. tools/fleetpropagate.sh does the lock refresh across the fleet and puts copier update behind an optin flag. Conformance: [preen](https://github.com/gojiplus/preen) runs check strict in every repo's CI and fails on drift from the standard. Adopting a repo uvx preen adopt retrofit an existing package uvx preen new mypackag
items.author: neehao
items.descZh: pycanon 是 gojiplus 团队为统一管理约 50 个 Python 代码仓库而构建的"单一版本化标准"项目，旨在消除跨仓库配置复制的繁琐工作。其核心机制采用 DRY 分层架构：CI/CD 与发布流程通过 5 行的可复用 workflow shim 引用 @v1 标签实现自动传播，Sphinx 文档配置通过 from py_canon.sphinx import configure 导入即用，而 ruff/pyright 等必须驻留在各仓库本地配置文件的部分则通过 copier 模板进行物化分发。项目内置了两项关键防护：通过 preen 工具在每个仓库 CI 中运行 check strict 模式检测配置漂移，并通过 tools/fleetpropagate.sh 批量刷新 uv 锁文件来弥补 copier update 因移动标签而失效的传播盲区。该方案特别适合维护多个具有统一规范的 Python 包的组织或开源舰队，新仓库可通过 uvx preen new 一键脚手架搭建，现有仓库则用 uvx preen adopt 完成标准化改造。

items.title: Show HN: Memcode Launches GitHub Code Review
items.desc: description: A reviewer on every pull request that reads the whole repository, comments only when something is actually wrong, and withdraws a call your tests disprove. title: Memcode AI image: https://memcode.ai/logoog.png Code review · pull requests · evidence · suggestions acme/payments · pull request 482 internal/broker/limit.go 89\ if calls b.maxCalls { 89\+ if calls = b.maxCalls { HighCall cap now rejects the final allowed call With a cap of 2 the second call is refused, so every build that uses its full budget fails at the last step. Suggested fix if calls b.maxCalls { Confirmed by CITestBrokerEnforcesCallCap Nothing posted on the other 6 changed files. A reviewer, not a linter. Connect a repository and every pull request gets read against the whole codebase, not just the diff. It comments when something is actually wrong, and stays quiet the rest of the time. [Connect a repository](/repos) Quiet by default Most review bots fail by talking too much. Everything here is tuned so that a comment means something is wrong. Nothing to say, nothing said A clean pull request gets no comment at all. No "looks good", no summary of what you already know. Nits stay unposted Anything below medium severity is recorded and kept off the pull request. Ten comments is the ceiling, and you can lower it. Push again, hear nothing twice Each push is reviewed against what was already reported. The same finding is never raised a second time. It reads the repository, not the diff The review runs against a real checkout. When a change alters an assumption, it goes looking for the code that depended on it, which is where the expensive bugs live and exactly what a diff cannot show. It reads the issues a pull request says it closes, so it can check the change against what it claims to do instead of guessing from the branch name. handlers/checkout.go \ req.Header.Set("IdempotencyKey", key) CriticalDropping this header breaks a caller elsewhere billing/refund.go:212 still expects the key to be set and retries on a timeout. Without it, a retried refund charges twice. Findings that carry evidence A review is a first pass, and your test suite finishes after it does. What CI learns gets attached to the finding it concerns. Review, 90 seconds after the push HighCall cap now rejects the final allowed call Confirmed by CITestBrokerEnforcesCallCap The check that corroborated it is named. Recorded on the existing comment, with no second notification. The same comment, once CI finished WithdrawnCall cap now rejects the final allowed call Disproved byTestBrokerEnforcesCallCap The finding said up front what would prove it wrong. That check passed, so the comment was withdrawn and the thread resolved, quietly. A finding is only ever withdrawn by a check it named itself. A generally passing suite is never treated as proof, because most of the time it means nothing tested that behaviour. Reviewed on your terms Every repository gets its own settings, changeable whenever. acme/payments Code ReviewReviews Enabled Reviews every pull request Severity shown Lower findings are recorded, not posted Tone How findings are worded Language Prose only, code is never translated Model Reviewing is a judgment task Comments per review Worst first, the rest are counted Committable suggestions Oneclick fixes on the diff PR walkthrough Summary on the first review Draft pull requests Skipped until marked ready Ignore paths One glob per line vendor/\\ dist/\\ House rules Layered on top, never a replacement Prefer tabledriven tests. Try the controls. Nothing here is saved. English, Spanish, Japanese, Portuguese, German, Chinese, and fourteen more. It comments. That is all. Code review never writes code, never opens a pull request, and never merges anything. It reads a checkout of the commit under review and posts comments. Suggested fixes are yours to accept or ignore. Access is granted per repository through a GitHub App you install, and you can revoke it from GitHub at any time. Put it on one repository Connect a repository, open a pull request, and read what comes back. items.author: timerwin
items.descZh: Memcode AI 是一款 GitHub 端的 AI 代码审查工具，通过 GitHub App 接入仓库后，对每个 PR 在真实 checkout 上针对全量代码库而非仅 diff 进行审查，并可读取 PR 所关联的 issue 以校验实现与诉求是否一致。其核心设计是"沉默优先"：默认保持静默，只对中等及以上严重度的问题发表评论，单 PR 评论上限为 10 条且可调，低严重度问题仅记录不发评论，同一发现不会在后续 push 中重复出现。最大亮点是基于证据的自撤回机制——审查发布时会预先声明可证伪它的 CI 测试名，若该测试通过，评论会被静默撤回并自动 resolve，且只有该评论自身点名的测试才能撤销它，避免泛绿套件造成的伪证；同时建议修复可一键提交到 diff。适用场景包括中大型团队希望减少噪音式 bot 评论、跨文件依赖导致的回归问题、以及对审查一致性与可追溯性要求严格的支付/计费/基础设施类仓库。
items.quote: 一个发现只能被它在自身中点名的检查所撤回。

items.author: Tarek-M
items.descZh: 该项目是一个用 Rust 编写的确定性 CPG(代码属性图)到 Nuclei YAML 编译器,配套提供 Docker 闭环验证测试环境。它以 Joern 作为底层 CPG 引擎,支持 C/C++、Java、Go、Python 等多语言源码输入,经数据流切片与污点分析后自动生成 ProjectDiscovery Nuclei 扫描模板,并通过 Docker harness 在隔离环境中执行 nuclei,产出 TP/TN 验证报告。仓库结构清晰,核心编译逻辑集中在 cpg_nuclei_core(包含 joern_cpg_bridge、cpg_schema、cross_tx_dfg、nuclei_exporter 等模块),templates/ 下提供 CVE-2024-51483 等真实模板用于端到端测试,docs/ 提供 Joern CLI 部署与架构说明。亮点在于"确定性"编译与闭环验证:同一份源码每次产出的 Nuclei YAML 保持稳定,且 Docker runner 会自动隔离运行 nuclei,避免对 Changedetection.io 等真实目标造成配置污染,同时支持"先快照—后扫描—再恢复"的非破坏性 SOP。典型场景为 SAST/AppSec 工程师需要把静态分析结果(数据流/污点可达漏洞)半自动转化为可执行的 Nuclei 模板,或在 CI 中对自家 nuclei 模板做回归验证。
items.quote: 确定性 Joern CPG 转 Nuclei YAML 编译器及 Docker 验证测试框架
